name: Cyclops (Blue Team)

abilityDetails.True Focus: Bu saldırılar Kaçış (Evade) ve Miss etkilerini yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Power Efficiency: Özel saldırıların güç maliyetini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Special Protection: Özel saldırılar sırasında ek hasar koruması sağlar.
abilityDetails.Adrenaline: Zamanla azalan beyaz bir can barı olarak depolanır. Saldırılarla verilen hasar, depolanan Adrenaline'i cana çevirir; bu dönüşüm İyileşme Engeli gibi etkilerden etkilenmez.

howToPlay: Cyclops (Blue Team) için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mutant sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
To Me, My X-men
Leading the charge, Cyclops stores [50 - 90]% of the damage taken from Bleeds and from Physical Thorns as Adrenaline.
For each other #X-Men Champion on the team, Cyclops enters his first fight with a Persistent Tactician Charge, each increasing his personal Prowess potency by +[0.2 - 2]% flat, and his personal True Focus and Precision durations by +1 second. Winning a fight grants Cyclops +1 Charge. Max stacks: 10.

abilitySections.title: Calm Under Pressure
content: Always at the ready, Cyclops's Defensive Ability Accuracy cannot be reduced.
As an Attacker, rather than running forward when not performing an action, Cyclops stands still. This stoicism unnerves the Opponent and makes them more aggressive.
Start each fight against non-Tech Champions with a True Focus Buff for 10 seconds, refreshed when gaining a personal Precision. If not active, it retriggers when Cyclops activates any Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Precision
content: A master marksman, Cyclops's Precision Passives increase his Critical Rating by +[144.74] for 10 seconds. These expire one at a time and are refreshed when he gains a new one. Max stacks: 20.
The third Basic Attack in a combo grants Cyclops a Precision Passive.
Intercepting the Opponent grants Cyclops a Precision Passive. Intercepting with a Special Attack grants +4 additional Precisions.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: At 10+ personal Precisions, Cyclops's Special Attacks are Passively Unblockable.
For each personal Precision, the first hit of a Special Attack that lands grants Cyclops a +20% Prowess Passive for 2 seconds. Max stacks: 100.
Personal effects are refreshed and paused during Cyclops's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain a 20% Power Efficiency Passive for 2 seconds. Max stacks: 2.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, gain a non-stacking 30% Power Efficiency Passive for 2 seconds.
On activation, gain 5 personal Precision Passives.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: On activation, gain a 5% Power Efficiency Passive for 2 seconds.
As an Attacker, this Special Attack can only be activated with at least 20 personal Precisions and only once per fight, but it costs 100% less Power.

abilitySections.title: Secret Ability - Special Protection
content: All Special Attack damage from Havok is reduced to 0.
